evidence.quote: Owned intelligence is not the same as rented intelligence.

observations.why: Contrasting 'owned' against 'rented' elevates ownership and self-determination over dependence on third parties.

evidence.quote: the perspective is the asset you keep

observations.why: Appeals to retaining one's own persistent perspective as an enduring asset rather than relying on ephemeral commodity substrates.

mints.name: OwnershipOverSubcontracting
mints.title: owned intelligence over rented intelligence
mints.frame: Does the expression locate value in retaining direct ownership and autonomy over one's assets rather than renting commodity capabilities?
